upload.fileHint: One .html file, or a .zip file with index.html at the top and its CSS, JavaScript, images (png, jpg, webp, gif, svg, ico) and woff2 fonts. At most 2 MiB, 100 files and two folder levels. Files load only from the page itself. %%DOMAIN%% in the HTML shows the domain the visitor opened.
